1.source: A permanent power boost for evil-aligned fighters.
1.translation: Un aumento de poder permanente para los luchadores de alineamiento malvado.

3.translation: Babidi, para jugadores de alineamiento malvado

5.source: Power ×1.3; the Majin "M" on your character
5.translation: Poder ×1.3; la "M" Majin en tu personaje

6.source: The '''Majin Mark''' is the brand of the wizard [[Special:MyLanguage/Babidi|Babidi]]. It gives you a '''permanent power boost''', ×1.3 by default, and puts the Majin "M" on your character. Only evil-aligned fighters can receive it.
6.translation: El '''Sello Majin''' es la marca del hechicero [[Special:MyLanguage/Babidi|Babidi]]. Te da un '''aumento de poder permanente''', ×1.3 por defecto, y pone la "M" Majin en tu personaje. Solo los luchadores de alineamiento malvado pueden recibirlo.

8.source: Talk to Babidi in [[Special:MyLanguage/Babidi's Spaceship|Babidi's Ship]] (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Structures|Structures]]) and choose '''Receive the Mark'''.
8.translation: Habla con Babidi en la [[Special:MyLanguage/Babidi's Spaceship|Nave de Babidi]] (consulta [[Special:MyLanguage/Structures|Estructuras]]) y elige '''Recibir el Sello'''.

9.source:
* You must be '''evil-aligned''': if your [[Special:MyLanguage/Alignment|alignment]] is 39 or higher, Babidi refuses. Below that, he brands you.
* If you are already marked, he has nothing more to give you.
9.translation:
* Debes tener '''alineamiento malvado''': si tu [[Special:MyLanguage/Alignment|alineamiento]] es 39 o más, Babidi se niega. Por debajo de eso, te marca.
* Si ya tienes el sello, no tiene nada más que darte.

11.source:
* Your power is multiplied by ×1.3 by default: your Strength, Strike Power and Ki Power get the full bonus, and your defense gets half of it.
* The Majin "M" appears on your character.
* Once marked, the mark stays with you permanently.
11.translation:
* Tu poder se multiplica por ×1.3 por defecto: tu Fuerza, tus Super Golpes y tu Poder de Ki reciben la bonificación completa, y tu defensa recibe la mitad.
* La "M" Majin aparece en tu personaje.
* Una vez marcado, el sello se queda contigo para siempre.

13.source: Admins can give or remove the mark with /dmzeffect give majin -1 [targets] and /dmzeffect remove majin [targets] (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Effects#Commands|Effects]]).
13.translation: Los administradores pueden dar o quitar el sello con /dmzeffect give majin -1 [targets] y /dmzeffect remove majin [targets] (consulta [[Special:MyLanguage/Effects#Commands|Efectos]]).
